basis: Owner direction 2026-10-28: Jet's build and package system must be lightning fast and substantially faster than Nix, as well as more powerful and easier to use, audit and reason about. Nix is a required peer.

project.shape: the mid-size build-time program (Tools/perf/build-time/midsize.mjs, 90 units) in 9 unit files plus the entry; Jet: a package whose @build.jet `build: fn` registers one executable; Nix: a flake whose stdenv.mkDerivation runs make over the same program in C (gcc -O1, parallel), nixpkgs pinned to the repository's flake.lock

peers.builds: jet build in the package root; JET_STORE_DIR under the work dir
the system daemon store with substitution off for local cells; a private local store and a file:// binary cache for cold_cache

cells.meaning: evaluate the build configuration without building
cells.prepare: nothing; the previous round left the project built
nothing; the previous build is current
append one new unused function to the peer's edit file

cells.meaning: build a checkout with no local build state while a populated cache or substituter holds the current build
cells.prepare: jet: remove the package's .jet directory and keep JET_STORE_DIR; nix: copy the current output to the file:// cache and delete it from the private store

cells.meaning: hermetic from-scratch build of the project with its toolchain present
cells.prepare: jet: remove the package's .jet directory and empty JET_STORE_DIR; nix: --rebuild runs the derivation again in its sandbox

fairness: one program, byte-identical output, validated after every timed build
fresh process per sample; peers interleaved, order alternating per round
Nix keeps its evaluation cache and its own toolchain closure; Jet keeps its shipped runtime and Core
Nix local cells run without substituter queries, so unreachable caches cost Nix nothing
comparator: ratio = jet median / nix median; eval, noop and incremental need ratio <= 0.25, cold_cache and scratch need ratio < 1.00; a failed command, wrong output or missing sample fails closed
